instagram:
Google par business kaise dale? Customer aapki dukaan dhoondhta hai, naam nahi milta, aur wo bagal wali dukaan pe chala jata hai. Maps pe dukaan daalna bilkul free hai. 📍

1. Naam aur pin: Google Maps kholiye, upar apni photo pe tap kijiye, Add your business chuniye. Sahi naam, sahi category, aur laal pin theek apni dukaan pe.

2. Number, time aur verify: phone number aur khulne ka time daaliye. Sunday band rehti hai to wo bhi likhiye. Phir verify kijiye. Verify ke baad hi dukaan customer ko dikhti hai.

3. Asli photos: bahar ka board, andar ka counter, aapka maal. Customer aane se pehle dukaan pehchaan leta hai.

Save kar lijiye, aaj hi apni dukaan Maps pe daaliye. Comment mein bataiye, aapki dukaan Google pe dikhti hai ya nahi? 👇
